FISHERMEN WARNING
FOR TAMIL NADU COAST
Day 1 (22.08.2026) Squally wind with speed 45-55 kmph gusting to 65 kmph is likely to prevail
to along & off South Tamil Nadu coast, Gulf of Mannar and adjoining Comorin
Day 5 (26.08.2026) area.
Fishermen are advised not to venture into the above sea areas during the above-mentioned period.
FOR OTHER THAN TAMIL NADU COASTS
Squally wind with speed 45-55 kmph gusting to 65 kmph is likely to prevail
over most parts of Westcentral adjoining few parts of Eastcentral Arabian Sea
and few parts of Southwest Bay of Bengal.
Day 1 (22.08.2026)
Squally Weather with wind speed 40-50 kmph gusting to 60 kmph is likely to
prevail along and off North Andhra Pradesh coasts adjoining some parts of
Westcentral Bay of Bengal and over Andaman Sea.
Squally wind with speed 45-55 kmph gusting to 65 kmph is likely to prevail
over some parts of Westcentral Bay of Bengal and few parts of Southwest Bay of
Bengal.
Day 2 (23.08.2026) Squally Weather with wind speed 40-50 kmph gusting to 60 kmph is likely to
prevail along and off North Andhra Pradesh coasts adjoining some parts of
Westcentral Bay of Bengal and over Andaman Sea.
Squally Weather with wind speed 35-45 kmph gusting to 55 kmph is likely to
prevail along and off Karnataka & Kerala coasts and Lakshadweep Area.
Squally wind with speed 45-55 kmph gusting to 65 kmph is likely to prevail
over some parts of Westcentral Bay of Bengal adjoining few parts of South Bay
of Bengal.
